title: An oracle with P equal to NP but unequal to BQP equal to P-sharpP

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard relativized quantum/classical/promise complexity models and imported Raz–Tal Forrelation, random-projection and query bounds
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact imported background statements and full original bibliography retained. Every source-local quantum simulation, concentration/restriction, oracle construction and diagonalization proof retained, including corrected v4 Lemma53.

core_obligations: Construct all three recursive oracle regions while respecting source query-length bounds.
Prove that the NP-answer region collapses P and NP and the Forrelation region realizes BQP=P-sharpP.
Use the full recursive AC0 simulation and hybrid/parity argument to preserve strict separation of the classical and quantum powers.
difficulty_reason: A non-routine recursive oracle combines a random region, Forrelation encodings of counting computations, and an NP-answer region. The complete recursive classical-query simulation and hybrid proof keep quantum counting power above P despite collapsing P and NP.
